title: RawEventEnvelope
description: Untranslated source event: what ingestion-service accepts on POST /ingest/v1/events and what it publishes to pdei.raw.events.v1. Mirrors com.laserpay.pdei.common.event.RawEventEnvelope. The body is kept exactly as the source system sent it so that a normalisation bug can be fixed and the stream replayed without asking the source systems for anything.

rawEventId.description: Assigned by ingestion-service when the submitter omits it. Present on every record published to pdei.raw.events.v1.

sourceSystem.description: Adapter identity, e.g. psp-adapter, order-system, logistics, crm.

sourceEventType.description: Source vocabulary (e.g. payment_intent.succeeded), NOT an EventType. normalization-worker owns the mapping.

aggregateId.description: Optional. When present, ingestion keys the Kafka record merchantId + ':' + aggregateId exactly as PLATFORM-CONTRACT section 4 requires; otherwise it resolves one from the body and finally falls back to the idempotency key.

occurredAt.description: Source-side time of the fact. Optional on submission.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable per-fact key. The HTTP Idempotency-Key header wins over this field.

headers.description: Flat string map of source transport headers plus PDEI-resolved hints.

body.description: The source payload, kept verbatim. Alias: payload.
